followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: Deliberate truck obstruction of Kenya’s Malaba exit and approaches is supported. Ordinary congestion and queue clearance are not by themselves new closure episodes. The selected movement is cargo from Kenya toward Uganda. Pedestrians and boda bodas passed blocked approaches; reverse-direction trucks faced later queue-clearance timing. No all-passenger international closure is claimed. Reports support physical blockage on 21 May 2020 and scoped resumption around 15:00 on 26 May. The conflicting account of three days from Monday is real and remains unresolved. Later union advice to stop services is not an observed renewed blockade; numerical continuous duration remains withheld. Drivers stated health-protocol and treatment grievances. The minister’s alternative incitement account is retained as competing attribution, rather than replacing the protestors’ stated reason or being merged into a single proved cause. Five relevant article bodies were freshly checked, including the start, local endpoint, opposing continuity account, ministerial statement and passage exceptions. Original Star URLs redirect to changed categories; the historical articles remain readable. Earlier R01 challenge involvement is disclosed. The phase remains unlocated pending B01. The text distinguishes the Malaba exit from blocked approach roads; no precise blocked lane or whole border line is inferred.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 75f71973a192fafd898d69eee3f642a94b186f28c8ab91f32c95fb2d2560df1a. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the full fixed sample audit of 16 parents and 27 phases, including 29 guarded input-cell corrections and the new Sadao onset question. Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R05-NQ06 — Keep REC50-R01-003-U01 open. Continuity between the dated endpoints and opposite-direction clearance remain unresolved despite a supported occurrence and scoped endpoint.
